description: Typed operational output of a Lexicon-governed decision (Trajectory Lexicon §16). Consumed by the execution layer through an explicit interface.

cumulative.description: True if evaluated via CumAdm over G_(0:t), Sigma_(0:t), Omega_(0:t).

recoveryPath.description: Required when HighConsequence(I): demonstrated or qualified recovery path.

consent.description: Consent tuple: capacity, information, specificity, voluntariness, revocability, scope, duration, verification.

proxyProvenance.description: Required when direct consent is impossible.

decisionRecord.description: The consequence record for the decision (§17.1 proof obligation).

claim.description: The claim, retaining type, regime, warrant, scope, provenance.

decisionId.description: Unique decision identifier (anchors into the Merkle audit log).

note.description: 'empty' = ∅ inapplicable: the question could not be posed; routes to question revision, never to 'nothing'.

provenance.description: Prov: source/instrument chain supporting evidence integrity.

regime.description: R0 precommitment: purpose, horizon, admittedOps, stopRules, revisionRules.

tested.description: Untested high-consequence recovery counts as degraded, not demonstrated.

revision.description: Revision boundary (§16.1, §21 step 19): model/causal/probability/trajectory updates with provenance of superseded state.

regimeDelta.description: Required when the regime changed post-result: old, new, independentReason, newVulnerability, authorization.

supersedes.description: decisionId of the superseded record; provenance preserved.

safetyState.description: Bound safety state (§13); binds the engine response per safety-state-mapping.md.

title: LexiconOutput
